prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. A family of eight seen from behind, their faces never visible, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, bundles on their shoulders, walks down a broad plank ramp onto wet green ground under a clearing sky. Bright morning. Grateful. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.

approved.note: Viewed: family from behind on plank ramp over green land, period robes, no faces.
